subject: Vendor accreditation, partial PO reissue & ledger split for Cirrus Metrics
messages:
From: Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@cirrusmetrics.com>
To: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cirrusmetrics.com
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding form + PO request (Cirrus Metrics)

Hi Monica —

Thanks for taking this. Attached is our completed vendor onboarding form and a short purchase request. Finance at Cirrus has a hard deadline for PO confirmation before Aug 1 so we can close Q3 budgeting. Two quick items we noticed in the intake:

- Preferred spend ceiling: $120,000/year (we asked for annual cap rather than monthly).
- Original line item on the intake was a single entry for ‘Platform + Support’. Our finance team needs the invoice to separate: Platform fees and Support retainer for internal mapping.

Can you confirm the earliest PO issuance window and whether Redwood supports provisional split POs (we'd accept two lines under one PO number) so our accounting can reconcile?

Attachment: [cirrus_onboarding_form_filled.pdf (application/pdf, 183KB)]

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we can be flexible on billing cadence once the PO is in place.

Best,
Ethan Lowe
Head of Procurement
Cirrus Metrics
ethan.lowe@cirrusmetrics.com
From: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@cirrusmetrics.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding form + PO request (Cirrus Metrics)

Hi Ethan — thanks, received.

We can absolutely support splitting the invoice across two line items under a single PO number (common pattern). A few things I need to confirm so we issue the correct PO and ledger mapping:

1) GL / cost-center for the Support retainer (so Laura can map ledger correctly).
2) Confirmation that $120,000 is the total annual cap and whether that should be evenly prorated for the remainder of the year or applied as an annual ceiling from activation date.
3) Do you require a provisional PO first (temporary number) or a final PO to start? We can issue a provisional PO with a Redwood prefix (PO-RED-...) that you can use for onboarding.

I'll loop in Priyom to do the provisional PO issuance once we have the mapping information. Laura — can you hold a provisional ledger slot for Cirrus Metrics and advise on the exact line labels we should use ("Platform - Product" vs "Support - Retainer")?

If easier, we can hop on a 15-minute call this afternoon.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
From: Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@cirrusmetrics.com>
To: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cirrusmetrics.com
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding form + PO request (Cirrus Metrics)

Monica — quick answers below, and attaching the completed onboarding form with the finance-approved GL codes.

- GL codes: Platform = 5201-PLTF; Support = 5203-SUPR (see filled form).
- $120,000 is the annual ceiling starting from the PO activation date. If we activate on Aug 1 we'll want it prorated for the remainder of the fiscal year, otherwise effective annual cap from activation is fine.
- Provisional PO is OK while legal completes final SOW sign-off — procurement prefers a provisional 14-digit PO prefixed with PO-RED so payments can be queued.

We are asking for:
Line 1: Platform fees — annualized equivalent of $10,000/mo (GL: 5201-PLTF)
Line 2: Support retainer — $2,500/mo (GL: 5203-SUPR)

Attachment: [cirrus_onboarding_form_filled.pdf (updated) (application/pdf, 185KB)]

Appreciate the help — if the provisional PO can be issued by Friday it would keep our internal timelines intact.

Cheers,
Ethan
From: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Onboarding form + PO request (Cirrus Metrics)

Folks — forwarding Cirrus' completed form and the GL codes. Quick ask: can Procurement issue a provisional PO (PO-RED) and set up two invoice lines with the mapping below? Also recommend we apply a "split authorization" token on the ledger so refunds/credits can be routed correctly.

Proposed PO lines (to appear on the generated PO):
- Line A | Platform - Product | GL: 5201-PLTF | Estimate: $120,000 cap applied annually; invoice monthly at $10,000 equivalent.
- Line B | Support - Retainer | GL: 5203-SUPR | Invoice monthly at $2,500.

We want the PO number issued as provisional: PO-RED-789412 (Prio: expedite). Please add an internal note: SPLT-AUTH=SPLT-42 so ledger team can enforce split routing on billing.

Attachments: [cirrus_onboarding_form_filled.pdf (application/pdf, 185KB)]

Priyom — can you confirm ETA for provisional PO and drop the PO mapping CSV back into thread when ready? Laura — once PO exists can you confirm ledger mapping and whether any manual journal entry is needed to align the first prorated invoice?

Thanks,
Monica
